captions.detailed: A 12-pounder field cannon featuring a smooth-bore bronze-colored barrel mounted on a wooden carriage. It features two large wooden-spoked wheels with dark metal rims, connected by a central black axle. The barrel can pitch vertically on its trunnion joints, the wheels rotate on their axle, and a small metal tow-ring at the rear of the trail carriage can swing on a hinge.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a Napoleonic 12-pounder field cannon, featuring a smooth-bore barrel on a wooden carriage with two large spoked wheels, incorporating revolute joints for barrel elevation, wheel rotation, and a rear tow-hook plate.
captions.factory: Construct the main chassis carriage using box primitives for the cheeks and trail. Create the smooth-bore barrel by lofting or unioning cylinders of varying diameters, adding a hollow bore and cylindrical trunnions. Build the wheels using a central hub cylinder, outer rim cylinders, and rectangular spokes patterned circularly. Assemble the parts using revolute joints for the wheel axles, the barrel trunnions, and the rear tow-ring assembly.
